question: What Settings localization contract should OpenClaw support for schema/uiHint-derived config labels, section metadata, and the existing partial PRs?
rationale: Toolbar chrome can follow the current t() pipeline, but schema-derived labels and generated config metadata need a maintainer-owned key/fallback design before automation should expand the surface.

options.title: Define one Settings i18n contract
options.body: Sponsor a single key/fallback design for Settings chrome, Quick Settings, section metadata, and schema labels, then rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

options.title: Land narrow chrome slices first
options.body: Accept the toolbar or Quick Settings PRs as partial improvements while keeping this issue open for schema/category labels.

options.title: Defer schema labels
options.body: Keep schema-derived labels English for now and narrow this issue to non-schema Settings UI chrome only.

recommendation.title: Define one Settings i18n contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a single key/fallback design for Settings chrome, Quick Settings, section metadata, and schema labels, then rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Settings UI refactor ownership makes steipete the best current routing point for the UX/API sequencing decision.
